results.title: Arcade Alternative — Rendemo
results.content:
Arcade is established, with a support organisation and a large customer base. Rendemo is new.

## Questions

### What is the best Arcade alternative?

Rendemo is an Arcade alternative for teams that want interactive demos built from the real HTML of their product. Arcade offers HTML capture only on its custom-priced Enterprise tier and charges $50 per seat per month for Growth, while Rendemo captures real HTML on its free plan and charges $39 per month flat for unlimited creators.

### How much does Arcade cost? [...] ### How is Rendemo different from Arcade?

Rendemo captures real product HTML on every plan including the free one, prices flat per workspace rather than per seat, does not meter AI usage in credits, and can define demos and tours as code in your repository so a UI change that breaks a tour fails your build. Arcade is stronger at AI-generated video and visuals and records from a desktop app and a Figma plugin.

### When should I choose Arcade over Rendemo?

Choose Arcade if you want AI to generate video and visuals from text prompts, if you need to record outside the browser from a Mac or Windows desktop app or from Figma, if you need SOC 2 compliance today, or if you need visitor account reveal. Rendemo offers none of those. [...] ## When Arcade is the better choice

Straight answer, because you will find this out in week two anyway:

Arcade generates video and visuals from a text prompt and charges credits for it. Rendemo renders video from a recording you made — it will not invent footage you never captured.

Arcade ships a Mac and Windows desktop app and a Figma plugin. Rendemo captures through a Chrome extension only, so a native app or a Figma file is out of scope by design.

Arcade lists SOC 2 compliance. Rendemo offers a security review on Enterprise but does not hold that certification, and for many procurement teams that ends the conversation.

Arcade's Audience Reveal deanonymizes visitor traffic. Rendemo reports step-level behaviour and captured leads, not visitor identity.

Rendemo is a Navattic alternative for teams that want unlimited real-HTML demos without paying by the seat. Navattic's free plan includes one HTML demo and unlimited demos start at $150 per month for a single seat, while Rendemo publishes three real-HTML demos free with unlimited creators and charges $39 per month flat for unlimited demos.

Account identification and buyer circle discovery tell you which companies viewed a demo and who else at that company did. Rendemo reports step-level behaviour and captured leads — it cannot tell you the account.

Navattic's pipeline impact reporting connects demo engagement to revenue in a way a RevOps team can defend in a board meeting. Rendemo gives you funnels and leads, and you would build that attribution yourself.

Where would _rive_ be a reasonable alternative to _rend_?

The words _rive_ and _rend_ can be used in similar contexts, but _rive_ occurs most often in figurative use.

a political party _riven_ by conflict

In what contexts can _split_ take the place of _rend_?

The synonyms _split_ and _rend_ are sometimes interchangeable, but _split_ implies a cutting or breaking apart in a continuous, straight, and usually lengthwise direction or in the direction of grain or layers.

_split_ logs for firewood

When is _tear_ a more appropriate choice than _rend_?

In some situations, the words _tear_ and _rend_ are roughly equivalent. However, _tear_ implies pulling apart by force and leaving jagged edges.

_tear_ up the letter

       Image 6More from M-W [...] How is the word _rend_ different from other verbs like it?

Some common synonyms of _rend_ are _cleave_, _rip_, _rive_, _split_, and _tear_. While all these words mean "to separate forcibly," _rend_ implies very violent or ruthless severing or sundering.

an angry mob _rent_ the prisoner's clothes

When can _cleave_ be used instead of _rend_?

While the synonyms _cleave_ and _rend_ are close in meaning, _cleave_ implies very forceful splitting or cutting with a blow.

a bolt of lightning _cleaved_ the giant oak

When might _rip_ be a better fit than _rend_?

Although the words _rip_ and _rend_ have much in common, _rip_ implies a pulling apart in one rapid uninterrupted motion often along a line or joint.

_ripped_ the shirt on a nail
